description:
Working at Freudenberg: "We will wow your world!" This is our promise. As a global technology group, we not only make the world cleaner, healthier and more comfortable, but also offer our 52,000 employees a networked and diverse environment where everyone can thrive individually. Be surprised and experience your own wow moments. Together with our partners, customers and the world of science, we develop leading-edge technologies, and excellent products and services for about 40 markets and for thousands of applications: seals, vibration control components, batteries and fuel cells, technical textiles, filters, cleaning technologies and products, specialty chemicals and medical products.

You support our team as Finance Professional with German

Responsibilities

  • Enters, checks and posts incoming invoices in SAP MM/FI (using electronic workflows);
  • Account reconciliation and account clarification (incl. WERE account reconciliation);
  • Preparation and execution of timely payment runs;
  • Execution of intercompany (IC) netting and reconciliation of IC balances;
  • Contact with suppliers and processing of reminders;
  • Participates in monthly, quarterly and year-end closing activities and records intercompany accounting in the Accounts payable sub-ledger;
  • Performs checking and accounting travel expense reports (SAP Concur experience is desirable);
  • Review, account assignment, and posting of bank statements in our ERP system;
  • Clarification of payment differences and monitoring in collaboration with external customers;
  • Cash pool reconciliation including posting of cash pool interest;
  • Receivables management (dunning process, etc.) in collaboration with external customers;
  • Period-end closing activities in accounts receivable and other affiliated procedures before moth closing (sending balance lists and aging reports);
  • Confirmation of account balance between the entities for audit purpose.

Qualifications

  • University degree in Economics/Accounting;
  • Several years of professional experience in similar position or in a related function in a professional environment (shared services desirable);
  • Good MS Office skills and SAP R3 (modules FI, MM);
  • Fluency in German and English (spoken and written);
  • Strong customer service orientation;
  • Reliability, willingness to work in a team, initiative and commitment
  • Effective time and self-management;
  • Analytical, structured way of working and high problem-solving ability;
  • Curiosity and understanding for innovations in the field of IT.

If you like to make a difference and if you would like to be a part of a growing, successful company, then this is the moment to join Freudenberg and become part of a great team!
